studio.h2: A small studio with a simple rule: respect people’s time.
studio.p1: Sole Via Entertainment LLC is an independent studio based in Bay Harbor Islands, Miami, Florida. We make calm games and useful everyday apps for families, in English, Portuguese and Spanish. We design, build and publish them ourselves, from the first sketch to the store listing, and keep them small on purpose: easy to learn, quick to use, nice to come back to.
studio.p2: Our games are free to play and supported by ads. That is a craft of its own, and we take it seriously: ads sit around the play, never on top of it, and nothing you need to enjoy a game is locked behind them.
studio.pr1_d: No sign-up, no email. Your records and settings stay on your device.
studio.pr2_d: On a plane, in a queue, underground — the games work without a connection.
studio.pr3_d: English, Portuguese and Spanish, in the game and on the store.
studio.pr4_d: Anonymous usage stats you can switch off in Settings, and Apple’s tracking prompt honored.
